$sessionId..write: auth != null && auth.token.provider != 'anonymous' && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('hostUid').val() == auth.uid) || (data.exists() && data.child('hostUid').val() == auth.uid))

$playerId..validate:
newData.hasChildren(['name', 'role', 'score', 'lastAnswer', 'answerTime']) && 
                         newData.child('name').isString() && 
                         newData.child('name').val().length <= 30 &&
                         (newData.child('role').val() == 'player' || newData.child('role').val() == 'spectator') &&
                         newData.child('score').isNumber() &&
                         (newData.child('lastAnswer').isNumber() || newData.child('lastAnswer').val() == null) &&
                         (newData.child('answerTime').isNumber() || newData.child('answerTime').val() == null)

newData.hasChildren(['selectedIndex', 'timeMs']) && 
                           newData.child('selectedIndex').isNumber() && 
                           newData.child('selectedIndex').val() >= 0 && 
                           newData.child('selectedIndex').val() <= 3 &&
                           newData.child('timeMs').isNumber() && 
                           newData.child('timeMs').val() >= 0
